data: raw/ drive CSVs (sha256-verified originals; file names differ from the master 'file' column: match with the canonical form YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS), drive_master.csv (file, date, distance_km, ev_valid, ev_dist_km, ev_rpm_dt_med_s, ens_outlier_v2), seasonal_drive_master.csv (file, thermal_regime). NOT tools/, tests/, compute_drive_summary_v6.py, analyses/M460_result*, CHANGELOG.md
method_refs: analyses/M432_spec.md section 2 (the released RPM engine-off rule, grid, alignment, debounce, odometer scale k)

definitions.population: P0 = drives with ev_valid true and not ens_outlier_v2 (NaN counts as not an outlier): 483. P_F = drives of P0 whose raw file has the fuel-rate column 'Витрати палива (L/h)' with >= 20 samples AND on the 1 s grid (tmin..tmax) the nearest-3s-tolerance coverage of the fuel rate, of RPM and of speed are each >= 0.95. Logged fuel rates above 40 L/h are treated as unknown (dropped) before alignment.
definitions.states: released 1 Hz grid; RPM-off = debounce(known & rpm <= 400, runs shorter than 3 samples take the previous state, first run exempt) & known; zero-fuel state ZF = debounce(fuel known & fuel <= 0, same rule) & fuel known; A = off & ZF, B = on & ZF, C = off & not ZF, D = on & not ZF (only seconds with RPM and fuel both known); distance of a state = sum of speed/3600 over its seconds times the released odometer scale k (odometer range / integrated distance).
definitions.quantities: percent of sum(distance_km over P_F): shareRpm = (A + C + RPM-off-with-unknown-fuel distance), shareZeroFuel = A + B, motored = B, inconsistent = C, diff = B - C. Intervals: day-clustered percentile bootstrap, cluster = drive_master date, the days with data of P_F, B = 4000, numpy default_rng(42), idx = rng.integers(0, D, (B, D)), counts = bincount per row, ratio of sums per draw, percentiles 2.5 / 97.5.
definitions.constructValidity: seconds with rpm > 2000, boost <= -0.70 bar, calculated load <= 8 % (all aligned with the 3 s nearest tolerance on the same grid); report how many also carry ZF (debounced).

return: JSON <2 KB: AGREE/DISAGREE per claim with differences; tolerance 0.01 pp on shares, 0.02 pp on interval limits, 1 km on the decomposition; say what you could not reproduce and why.
